title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome is now generally available on all paid plans, enabling Claude to read web pages and autonomously perform actions like clicking, typing, and filling forms. New autonomous action capability auto-approves safe actions, reducing friction, while strengthened prompt-injection defenses provide enhanced security.

title: Reducing cost and improving performance with Claude Platform
summary: Anthropic published guidance on cutting Claude Platform costs through prompt caching, removing outdated anti-patterns, and calibrating the effort parameter. New claude-api skill commands enable prompt auditing and cost optimization, with real-world benchmarks showing 50-73% cost reductions while maintaining or improving accuracy.

title: Building commerce agents with Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a commerce blueprint on GitHub with reference implementations for retail, travel, telecom, and ticketing. The blueprint includes integration points for catalogs, carts, and checkout, works across Claude API and cloud platforms (Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, Vertex AI), and shows real impact: 35% larger carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates.

title: A guide to the anatomy of effective commerce agents
summary: This guide recommends a single-agent-with-skills architecture for commerce applications, outperforming both one-prompt and multi-agent designs on quality, cost, and latency. It covers optimization strategies, production safety (including asynchronous memory and staged writes), and evaluation practices for non-deterministic agents.

title: Claude for Teachers, now available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts
summary: Anthropic launched a free Enterprise offering for U.S. K-12 schools and districts with centrally managed accounts, SSO, and role-based access controls. New teaching tools include lesson preparation and standards-aligned assessment features, with FERPA compliance ensuring student data is never used for training.

title: Claude's memory works everywhere, and you decide what's in it
summary: Claude's unified memory now syncs across chat and Cowork with active updates during conversations rather than post-session summaries. Users can view, edit, and delete individual memory topics in settings, with sensitive topics excluded by default, available on all plans across web, desktop, and mobile.
